issuer: the Driver and Vehicle Licensing Department (the licensing authority), 4-6 Eastern Beach Road
note: Read 2026-10-30. The Traffic Act 2005 (the consolidation of 15 July 2026 on gibraltarlaws.gov.gi): s 31, the minimum age for category B is 18 years (a learner may learn from over seventeen, s 34); s 32(1) licences are issued only to applicants who have passed the theory and skills tests and are normally resident in Gibraltar; s 32(2)(a) a licence for categories AM to BE has an administrative validity of 15 years. The Government's Driving licences page: the licence is issued once the two parts of the test are passed, and 'Driving licence entitlement expires when a driver reaches the age of 70' (renewed every three years after on a medical certificate, free), so the licence is held for 15 years ending at 70 at most (untilAge). The Traffic (Licensing and Registration) Regulations (consolidation of 3 September 2026), Schedule 2 Part V, fee 1: £51.00 for the issue or renewal of a driving licence, £3 a year where it is issued for less than 10 years; the £51.00 is held (the category B test's £56.50, Part VII, and the learner's licence aren't). The identity card is the ids engine's; exchanges weren't read into a list.
